title: metadata fails to generate with: ExtraService failed while processing [SeriesScannedEvent]: Sequence contains more than one element
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

was trying to figure out why sonarr fails to get generate metadata files, and found this error

```
System.InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains more than one element
   at System.Linq.ThrowHelper.ThrowMoreThanOneElementException()
   at System.Linq.Enumerable.TryGetSingle[TSource](IEnumerable`1 source, Boolean& found)
   at System.Linq.Enumerable.SingleOrDefault[TSource](IEnumerable`1 source)
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Others.OtherExtraFileRenamer.RemoveOtherExtraFile(Series series, String path) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Others/OtherExtraFileRenamer.cs:line 69
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Others.OtherExtraFileRenamer.RenameOtherExtraFile(Series series, String path) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Others/OtherExtraFileRenamer.cs:line 38
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Metadata.MetadataService.ProcessEpisodeMetadata(IMetadata consumer, Series series, EpisodeFile episodeFile, List`1 existingMetadataFiles)
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Metadata.MetadataService.CreateAfterSeriesScan(Series series, List`1 episodeFiles) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Metadata/MetadataService.cs:line 108
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.ExtraService.Handle(SeriesScannedEvent message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/ExtraService.cs:line 138
   at NzbDrone.Core.Messaging.Events.EventAggregator.PublishEvent[TEvent](TEvent event)
```

### Expected Behavior

metadata is generated

### Steps To Reproduce

happens when i click on a series and click "Refresh and Scan", however its selective on what fails and what doesn't

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: archlinux
- Sonarr: sonarr-bin-4.0.14.2939-1
- Docker Install: No
- Using Reverse Proxy: (not that i know of)
- Browser: Firefox
- Database: Sqlite 3.49.1
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?
```
[v4.0.14.2939] System.InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains more than one element
   at System.Linq.ThrowHelper.ThrowMoreThanOneElementException()
   at System.Linq.Enumerable.TryGetSingle[TSource](IEnumerable`1 source, Boolean& found)
   at System.Linq.Enumerable.SingleOrDefault[TSource](IEnumerable`1 source)
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Others.OtherExtraFileRenamer.RemoveOtherExtraFile(Series series, String path) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Others/OtherExtraFileRenamer.cs:line 69
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Others.OtherExtraFileRenamer.RenameOtherExtraFile(Series series, String path) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Others/OtherExtraFileRenamer.cs:line 38
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Metadata.MetadataService.ProcessEpisodeMetadata(IMetadata consumer, Series series, EpisodeFile episodeFile, List`1 existingMetadataFiles)
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.Metadata.MetadataService.CreateAfterSeriesScan(Series series, List`1 episodeFiles) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/Metadata/MetadataService.cs:line 108
   at NzbDrone.Core.Extras.ExtraService.Handle(SeriesScannedEvent message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Extras/ExtraService.cs:line 138
   at NzbDrone.Core.Messaging.Events.EventAggregator.PublishEvent[TEvent](TEvent event)
```


### Anything else?

honestly first thing i thought when metadata failed to generate was a permissions issue, so i went to the logs to confirm, and saw this instead

comments.author: mynameisbogdan
comments.body:
What are those 2 errors from system > health? 

To be honest, sounds like a messy setup and you should actually use the sonarr's import capability instead of symlinking from series path to download folders.

comments.author: 9thyear2
comments.body:
1. RSS sync not available (i turned it off)
2. download client not available (didn't set it up)

reasons: when watching anime the dub releases have a delay / trail behind the sub releases (usually by a few weeks / episodes, if the show releases sub and dub on the day the dub usually has a few hour delay). so since sonarr gets the releases as soon as its available. it always pulls the sub releases. so i have to go delete those and replace them with the correct files. so i fixed it by not setting up the download client

however then it was still queuing up downloads, and since it was queuing things with rss, it wouldn't detect the files i placed manually (as i had something queued, so i turned off rss

i wanted to keep monitoring on so i could see what episodes are missing and where the seasons are incomplete, when monitoring is off, the season just shows green as if the episodes given are all the episodes available and there are no missing episodes

TLDR last paragraph example: unmonitored would show 98/98 green, while monitored shows 98/100 red. i want to know if anything is missing at a glance
